title: A Study of EUR-1066 in Subjects With Chronic Pancreatitis, Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency and Chronic Abdominal Pain
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate two different treatments in subjects with chronic pancreatitis, exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and chronic abdominal pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Chronic Pancreatitis
* Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency
* Chronic abdominal pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acute pancreatitis
* Active alcohol consumption
* Uncontrolled diabetes
